collection.name: Mysterious Orange by Eka
collection.description: Introducing Mysterious Orange — a hauntingly elegant depiction of La Catrina, the iconic figure of the Día de los Muertos tradition.Here, she stands shrouded in mystique, holding a glowing pumpkin as if revealing secrets of the season. Enveloped by layers of shadowy bats and delicate spider webs, her presence is both graceful and eerie, drawing viewers into an immersive Halloween-inspired scene.The artwork comes alive with an AR experience powered by Artivive, inviting an exploration beyond the surface into the hidden, layered depths of this supernatural celebration.
